messages.text: Morning everyone. Quick round first, then two topics: the Harbourline pilot rollout and the slow minute on the sync gateway this morning. Kai, you start.
Yesterday I finished the operation log table for offline sync and the batch upload endpoint. Today is the client queue. Two conflict-rule tests are still red, so that is where the day goes.
Barcode scanning works on both test phones. The old Android 10 phone is slow to focus, so today I am trying continuous autofocus. Not blocked.
Signature capture is in review. Today I start the job list filters. Also, the sync gateway answered very slowly for about a minute around nine.
That slow minute is how the September outage started, and we only found out because a customer phoned us. Kai, where are we on the expiry alert from the postmortem?
Not started. The renewal job is back on, but nothing warns us if it fails. It is ticket 13 on the Plan page. I can do the alert this week, 21 days before expiry.
Please do. That goes to the top of your list. It pages the on-call when it fires.
Good. Next topic: the pilot. Zara asked yesterday whether offline sync goes on for every Harbourline technician or only for the first group.
Right. If something goes wrong in the field, I would rather it hurt a few people than all of them.
Agreed. Decision: offline sync goes to the first pilot group only, behind the feature flag. If the first two weeks are clean, we open it to everyone else.
Does the flag live on the server or in the app build?
On the server, so we can switch a group on or off without a release.

Back to scanning. Continuous autofocus fixes the slow focus on the Android 10 phone, but it drains the battery faster. I would use it only on Android 10 and older and keep normal focus everywhere else.
Any objection? Okay. Decision: continuous autofocus is the default on Android 10 and older, normal focus on newer phones.
Good. That stays inside the scanner ticket, so no new ticket is needed.
Next, Vietnamese. The translator sent a first draft, but no native speaker has read it yet. Do we ship the draft in the pilot, or wait for the review?
Wait. A wrong word on a safety checklist is worse than no translation. Decision: Vietnamese ships only after a native speaker has reviewed it.
Understood. I will book a reviewer this week.
Leo, you are the release owner for the 27 October train. Can you draft the release notes by Monday?
Yes, I will have them ready by Monday.
One thing I cannot answer: will all of Harbourline's technicians get the next Android update, or are some phones stuck on Android 10 for good? It decides how long we have to support it.
I do not know, and I do not think anyone does yet. Let us leave it open for now.
A risk for the record: if the two failing conflict tests turn out to be a design problem and not a bug, the offline sync date on the roadmap could slip. I should know more tomorrow.
Noted, we keep the date for now. Owen, one more thing: please send me the PushRelay renewal numbers by Friday so I can decide before the notice deadline.
Will do. Thanks all, that is the standup.
